headline: A 2000 executive order created a protected reserve for the coral reefs of the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands.
what_it_does: This executive order set up a Coral Reef Ecosystem Reserve covering the coral reefs and nearby ocean waters of the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. Based on the title alone, its purpose was to protect that reef ecosystem. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, boundaries, and limits are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People who fish, dive, or run boats in the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands
who_it_affects.how: Activities in the reserve area may be subject to new federal protections or limits, though the details are not given in the title.
They would likely be responsible for managing and protecting the new reserve.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 4, 2000; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
